faq.q: Is June a good month for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes — June is one of the best months. Average air temperature is 27°C, sea temperature 22°C, and you’ll get 12 hours of sunshine daily. Rain is virtually non-existent (0-1 days). Calm winds of 10-15 knots make for smooth cruising along the Costa del Sol.

faq.q: What is the water temperature in Marbella in June?
faq.a: The Mediterranean sea temperature averages 22°C in June. That’s warm enough for comfortable swimming, snorkelling, and water sports. By late June it can reach 24°C, especially in sheltered coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

faq.q: Do I need to bring a jacket for a June boat trip?
faq.a: For daytime cruising, no — a light T-shirt and shorts are fine. However, after sunset or if you’re heading out early morning, a thin windbreaker or jumper is advisable as the breeze on the water can feel cooler. Sunscreen and a hat are essential (UV index 9).

faq.q: How many rainy days can I expect in Marbella in June?
faq.a: June is the start of the dry Mediterranean summer. You can expect 0 to 1 rainy days for the entire month, with total precipitation under 5 mm. The chance of rain affecting your charter is extremely low — less than 5% on any given day.

faq.q: What boat is best for a June charter in Marbella?
faq.a: For a couple or small group, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are quick and fun. For larger parties, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers shade and sun decks. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) even includes a free jet ski.

faq.q: Can I swim from the boat in June?
faq.a: Absolutely. The sea is warm at 22°C, and all our boats anchor in calm, clear bays. Popular swim stops include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the waters off Cabopino. Most charters include snorkelling equipment — just ask your skipper.

faq.q: What is the sunset time in Marbella in June?
faq.a: Sunset in Marbella during June is around 21:40 – 21:50 (9:40–9:50 PM). That gives you plenty of time for a late-afternoon charter or a sunset cruise with cava and snacks. The Golden Mile and La Concha views are stunning at that hour.

faq.q: Do I need to book a June charter in advance?
faq.a: Yes — June is peak season. Boats like the Pershing 46, Ferretti 94, and Mangusta 80 book out weeks ahead. We recommend reserving at least 2-3 weeks in advance, especially for weekends. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing.

data.body_html:
June is the sweet spot for a boat rental in Marbella. The June weather boat rental Marbella 2042 forecast shows average highs of 30°C, sea temperatures of 22°C, and only 0-1 rainy days. With 12 hours of sunshine and calm 10-15 knot winds, it’s the ideal month to explore the Costa del Sol from the water. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance — so you just show up and enjoy.

Average June Temperatures in Marbella

Daytime air temperatures in Marbella during June average 27°C, with highs often reaching 30°C by mid-afternoon. Evenings cool to around 20°C, making sunset cruises comfortable without needing heavy layers. The sea temperature sits at 22°C — warm enough for swimming without a wetsuit. Compared to July and August (which hit 33-35°C), June offers a more pleasant heat, especially for guests who prefer not to bake on deck.

Rainfall and Sunshine Hours

June is the start of the dry Mediterranean summer. Total rainfall for the month is typically under 5 mm, falling on at most one day. You can expect 12 hours of daily sunshine, with UV index peaking at 9 (high). A good SPF 50+ sunscreen, a hat, and polarised sunglasses are essential. The low humidity (around 60%) keeps the heat feeling dry and comfortable.

Wind and Sea Conditions

The prevailing wind in June is the Poniente (west wind), blowing at 10-15 knots — enough for a gentle breeze but not enough to create uncomfortable chop. The Mediterranean is calm, with wave heights rarely exceeding 0.5 metres. This makes June perfect for families, first-time boaters, and anyone prone to seasickness. All our boats are stable, from the 8m Dubhe to the 29m Ferretti 94.

Best Boats for June Weather

For small groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are nimble and fun. For larger parties, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers both shaded saloon and open flybridge — perfect for sunbathing or escaping the heat. If you want a free jet ski, book the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

What to Wear and Pack

For daytime: swimwear, a light T-shirt, shorts, and non-marking deck shoes. Bring a thin windbreaker or jumper for the return trip after sunset. Sun protection is non-negotiable: SPF 50+, a wide-brimmed hat, and UV-blocking sunglasses. Don’t forget a towel, a dry bag for electronics, and a reusable water bottle (though we provide bottled water, soft drinks, beer, and cava onboard).

Popular June Itineraries from Puerto Banús

Most June charters head east toward Cabopino (30 min) for quiet coves, or west to Estepona (45 min) for its old town and beach clubs. The Calas del Faro and Cala Cortés are favourite swim stops, with crystal-clear water and rocky cliffs. For a longer trip, Sotogrande (1.5 hours) offers luxury marina dining. Sunset cruises along the Golden Mile with views of La Concha mountain are unforgettable.

Booking Tips for June 2042

June is peak season. Boats like the Pershing 46, Ferretti 94, and Mangusta 80 book out weeks ahead. We recommend reserving at least 2-3 weeks in advance, especially for weekends. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours — all inclusive. For other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. Contact us early to secure your preferred date.
